IS 9951 : 2024 Thoracic Surgery Instruments - Blunt End Scissors - Specification
ICS 11.040.30
ICS 11.040.30
MHD 06

1 SCOPE
This standard covers dimensional and other requirement for Nelson pattern, blunt end scissors used in cardio-vascular surgery.
2 REFERENCES
The standard given below contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
